chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from al-'Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I asked one of the two, peace be upon them, about the deceased, and he said: "He is drawn out from the direction of the feet, and the grave is made level with the ground except to the measure of four spread fingers, and his grave is made square."

key_terms.الرِّجْلَيْنِ: the two feet; the direction from which the deceased is taken out
key_terms.مُفَرَّجَاتٍ: spread apart, indicating the manner of measurement
key_terms.يُسَلُّ: is drawn out or removed gently

ai.seo_question: How should a deceased person be buried according to this hadith from Tahdhib al-Ahkam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal guidance concerning the burial of the deceased. It states how the body is to be removed, how high the grave should be raised above the ground, and that the grave should be formed in a square shape.
